name: auditorium-management
description: College Auditorium Management System built with React and Node.js

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend && npm run install-webapp && npm run install-admin-app
scripts.user-admin: concurrently -n "SERVER,USER,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run webapp" "npm run admin-app"
scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run webapp" "npm run admin-app"
